items.title: Jensten specialist highlights media cyber exposure and policy gaps
items.summary: Jensten cyber specialist Dan Winn warns that business interruption from system downtime poses a greater threat to media clients than data breaches.

items.title: Industry urges ringfencing of guarantees in DWP small pot pension consolidation
items.summary: Pension bodies have warned the government that small pot consolidation must protect member guarantees without overburdening schemes.

items.title: Morgan Stanley Investment Management launches European active ETF platform
items.summary: Morgan Stanley Investment Management has entered the European active ETF market with the introduction of four Ireland-domiciled UCITS ETFs.

items.title: UniCredit CEO estimates Generali partnerships could generate up to €2.0 billion in value
items.summary: UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel said commercial partnerships with Generali could create up to €2.0 billion in value while leaving the insurer independent.

items.title: Supercede secures reinsurance technology agreements with Inigo and Ascot
items.summary: Reinsurance technology provider Supercede has expanded its market reach with long-term platform agreements covering Inigo and Ascot.

items.title: Insurance Business names top UK claims providers for 2026 report
items.summary: Insurance Business UK has identified 10 top insurers and claims providers in its latest annual report based on broker feedback.
